Senses.Note: The rebuke tells an interlocutor not to deceive others and is repeatedly answered by reversing the charge.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The compact admonition tells someone that it is better not to deceive people.
EvidenceBody: Dialogue witnesses assign the rebuke turn by turn, often provoking a reply that reverses the accusation.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Dialogue witnesses assign the rebuke turn by turn, often provoking a reply that reverses the accusation.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The rebuke tells an interlocutor not to deceive others and is repeatedly answered by reversing the charge.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: Initial rebuke and quoted recurrence remain the same warning despite changes of interlocutor.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The alias makes the advisory force of 好 explicit without softening the charge of deception.

ModifierControls.Finding: 人 is the object of 瞞, while 好 marks the recommended alternative.

FamilyControls.Finding: Reversed replies are response moves and do not become additional meanings of the rebuke.
